column2: The Avatar has arrived in [From.GetTitledFirstName]'s court.
The Avatar has exited withdrawal, performing their duties once again.
It was my honour to help.
The Avatar will take service with you and train your young courtiers.
You have publicly endorsed [avatar_interfere_target.GetTitledFirstName]. Your words lend their rule the weight of the Avatar's blessing.
You have publicly condemned [avatar_interfere_target.GetTitledFirstName]. The world has heard the Avatar's judgement.
You have turned your will upon the affairs of [avatar_interfere_target.GetTitledFirstName]. Where the Avatar acts, the world takes note.
